destination.name: Jinhua
destination.tagline: A central Zhejiang hub known for ham, caves and a Taiping prince's mansion
destination.description: Jinhua is a city in central Zhejiang and a transport hub for the province. Its best-known sights sit just outside the centre: Shuanglong Cave, where visitors pass through a narrow entrance lying in a small boat, and Jinhua Mountain, with a Huang Daxian temple and a belt of over 50 caves. In the old city, the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Shiwang Mansion is a museum of murals and rebellion exhibits. The city is also famous for Jinhua ham.
whyVisit: Lie back in a boat through caves
Explore temples and caves on the mountain

goodToKnow.title: Use the high-speed station
goodToKnow.detail: Jinhua South is the high-speed hub, and the older Jinhua station is in the city centre. Yiwu Airport is the nearest airport, with shuttle buses to the city.

goodToKnow.title: Expect summer downpours
goodToKnow.detail: Heavy rain falls from June to September, with thunderstorms. Plan outdoor and cave visits for spring or autumn.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Best in {months}, with days around 20 to 25°C. Summers are warm and very wet.
